title: CAO Retail Non-Food 2026-2027, bijlage 1b - loonregels per branche

progressionRule.condition: Zeer goed of uitmuntend functioneren: 1 of 2 treden van 2%; voldoende: geen tredeverhoging; matig of onvoldoende: geen cao- of tredeverhoging; medewerkers jonger dan 21 jaar ontvangen alleen leeftijdsverhogingen.
progressionRule.derivedStepDisplay: Previous exact hourly rate multiplied by 1.02, then rounded half-up to cents for the displayed table rate.
progressionRule.employerSelectionRequired: Choose the applicable progression approach: performance-dependent or non-performance-dependent, per Appendix 1a.
progressionRule.payrollApplication: Do not advance a person to a percentage-derived step without a verified, approved evaluation result. Under-21 employees use only the age scale.

branches.branch: Mode, Juweliers, Parfumerieën, Verf en Woninginrichting, Tabaks- en Gemakswinkels
